name: Open Project Context for a repository without a clone
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, open Project Context from the sidebar and confirm the page shows the 'Clone not available' state. The seeded demo repo acme/payments-api has clonePath: null (server/src/db/seed.ts), so discovery answers clone_available: false instead of an error. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the demo repo is the first repo — guaranteed by the e2e-web.yml workflow's fresh seed; run locally against a clean DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: open Project Context from the sidebar
navigate to the Project Context route
